stories.title: Detenido en Alemania el presunto 'cerebro' financiero del caso Plus Ultra

en.title: Arrested in Germany the alleged financial 'mastermind' of the Plus Ultra case
en.summary: German authorities arrested Simon Leendert Verhoeven, who investigators believe played a key financial role in a scheme involving former Spanish President Zapatero.

stories.title: Sánchez acusa en la CNN a los socios europeos de «insolidaridad» con Ceuta y admite por primera vez que Rabat «falló»

en.title: Sánchez accuses European partners on CNN of 'lack of solidarity' with Ceuta and admits for the first time that Rabat 'failed'
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez stated in a CNN interview that the European Union showed insufficient solidarity during the Ceuta crisis and acknowledged Morocco's role in the situation.

stories.title: Detenido en Alemania un financiero neerlandés clave en el ‘caso Plus Ultra’

en.title: Arrested in Germany a Dutch financier key to the 'Plus Ultra case'
en.summary: German authorities arrested banker Simon Leendert Verhoeven, a central figure in an investigation involving the Plus Ultra rescue scheme.

stories.title: El juez que investiga a Zapatero interrogará este viernes al epicentro del caso Plus Ultra tras ser detenido

en.title: The judge investigating Zapatero will question this Friday the epicenter of the Plus Ultra case after his arrest
en.summary: A Spanish investigating judge will question Simon Leendert Verhoeven on Friday after his arrest in Germany and extradition to Spain regarding the Plus Ultra case.

stories.title: Sánchez señala por primera vez a Marruecos por la entrada masiva en Ceuta: "Su control fronterizo falló"

en.title: Sánchez points to Morocco for first time over mass entry into Ceuta: "Its border control failed"
en.summary: Spain's prime minister stated in a CNN interview that Morocco is responsible for a major border breach in Ceuta, saying the country's border control failed and demanding responses and action from Rabat.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez busca a Sánchez en la ONU y él le traslada su compromiso con Venezuela

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez seeks out Sánchez at the UN and he conveys his commitment to Venezuela
en.summary: Venezuela's interim president met briefly with Spanish Prime Minister Sánchez during the UN General Assembly opening session in New York, in an unscheduled encounter that appeared to be arranged by both parties.

stories.title: Sánchez reconoce por primera vez que falló el “control fronterizo” de Marruecos en el asalto a Ceuta

en.title: Sánchez acknowledges for the first time Morocco's failed "border control" in the assault on Ceuta
en.summary: Spain's prime minister expressed concern in New York about insufficient EU solidarity regarding the Ceuta incident, contrasting it with Spain's support for Italy during the Lampedusa crisis.

stories.title: Sánchez asegura que ha pedido “acciones” a Marruecos “porque su control de fronteras falló” en Ceuta

en.title: Sánchez assures he has demanded "action" from Morocco "because its border control failed" in Ceuta
en.summary: Spain's prime minister told CNN that Morocco bears responsibility for the July 30-31 border incursion in Ceuta, while maintaining that bilateral relations remain good.

stories.title: La Policía detiene en Alemania al cerebro financiero del 'caso Plus Ultra'

en.title: Police arrest financial mastermind of 'Plus Ultra case' in Germany
en.summary: German police have detained Simon Leendert Verhoeven, considered a key figure in money laundering involving illicit Venezuelan funds.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez saluda a Pedro Sánchez en la ONU y le pide seguir hablando sobre la Venezuela

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez greets Pedro Sánchez at the UN and asks him to continue discussing Venezuela
en.summary: Venezuela's leadership greeted Spain's president at the United Nations and requested ongoing dialogue. The Spanish government expressed commitment to the country's future.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez busca a Sánchez en la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas y le pide una reunión para hablar de Venezuela

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez seeks out Sánchez at the UN General Assembly and requests a meeting to discuss Venezuela
en.summary: Venezuela's leader approached Spain's president at the United Nations seeking a meeting about Venezuela, referencing a controversial 2020 visit to Spain.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez se acerca a Sánchez en la ONU y ambos acuerdan mantener el contacto sobre el futuro de Venezuela

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez approaches Sánchez at the UN and both agree to maintain contact on Venezuela's future
en.summary: Spain's president and Venezuela's leadership agreed to keep communication channels open at the United Nations regarding the country's future.

stories.title: Sánchez pide ahora respuestas a Marruecos por Ceuta: "Su control de fronteras falló"

en.title: Sánchez now demands answers from Morocco over Ceuta: "Its border control failed"
en.summary: Spain's leader addressed the UN General Assembly in New York and pointed to Morocco's responsibility for the recent Ceuta crisis, citing failures in border control management.

stories.title: El jefe de Glovo, a un paso de juicio por emplear a repartidores como falsos autónomos

en.title: Glovo's chief faces imminent trial over employing delivery workers as false self-employed
en.summary: The head of the delivery platform is approaching trial regarding allegations of misclassifying delivery couriers as independent contractors rather than employees.

stories.title: Rosa Clará crece en Estados Unidos con tres nuevas tiendas

en.title: Rosa Clará expands in the United States with three new stores
en.summary: The Spanish bridal and formal wear company is opening its own retail locations in Boston, Atlanta, and will add another in Washington.

stories.title: Talgo peleará con Alstom para fabricar los primeros trenes de alta velocidad de Portugal

en.title: Talgo will compete with Alstom to manufacture Portugal's first high-speed trains
en.summary: The Portuguese public railway company has limited bidding to two candidates for a 504 million euro contract to supply twelve high-speed train units.

stories.title: GWM lanzará siete modelos en España: "Hemos llegado para quedarnos"

en.title: GWM to launch seven models in Spain: "We are here to stay"
en.summary: Chinese automaker GWM has begun operations in Spain with the Ora 5 launch and over 40 sales points. The company plans to introduce seven new models and capture 3% market share within two to three years through a multi-energy strategy.
